_README: Smoke-test fragment for the corpus AT-loss trainers. Merge the 'robust_loss' object below into the dataset's plans.json (or dataset.json) under the 'robust_loss' key, then select the corpus loss by TRAINER NAME at launch: nnUNetv2_train <DATASET> 3d_fullres <FOLD> -tr nnUNetTrainerNuAT (or nnUNetTrainerUIAT / nnUNetTrainerLBGAT). The plain TRADES baseline is -tr nnUNetTrainerRobustLoss. These values are for plumbing validation only (a 1-epoch run that reaches the adversarial phase immediately), NOT real training. nnUNetTrainerLBGAT raises NotImplementedError (frozen reference-model loading not wired).
